facts.fact: Nigeria's reforms under the NIMC Act, 2026 include the ID authority taking responsibility for the country's PKI system, per Biometric Update.

NGA.note: The document does not mention the civil register.

facts.fact: The NIMC Director General said 136 million registrations had been reached, up from over 120 million on 10 July; against the 237.5 million population given that is about 57%, calculated here.

NGA.note: The learner ID is a student number, not a number at birth.
Operation and maintenance are not stated.

facts.fact: A planned integration of the national identity system with the National Health Insurance program is among the reforms, per the article.
NIMC says 136 million Nigerians are registered in the National Identity Database.
